name: sentinel-optimizer
description: Client-side Sentinel migration and cost-optimization analysis for SIEM ingestion, with privacy-preserving local processing.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:engine && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
